_readme: Evaluation fixtures for CC-11 hybrid search.
Production data cannot serve as an evaluation set: it holds 7 doubts, most
titled things like 'New Title 2'. This corpus is synthetic but realistic,
and is checked in so results are reproducible.
Queries are deliberately mixed so the comparison is honest rather than
paraphrase - worded differently from the doubt (favours vector)
exact      - shares distinctive literal terms (favours keyword/fts)
morphology - same words, different inflection (favours fts stemming)
hard       - little literal overlap AND close neighbours in the corpus
If keyword wins overall, that is a publishable result, not a bug.

corpus.subject: DSA
corpus.title: Explain binary search
corpus.description: I do not understand how binary search narrows down the range each step. Can someone walk through it with an example array?
